method: Catalog, source placements, statics and selected action annotations: candidate edges, not proof of geometry, unlock reachability, completeness, renewable stock or player experience.

definition.name: Mechanical Parts
definition.desc: Found in industrial wrecks or made at a bench. Improve tools or maintain equipment.

special: crafted workbench batch, finite wreck yield, or finite factory crate (new runs only)

definition.name: Forged Fasteners
definition.desc: Found on wrecks or made from iron and scrap. Used for field repairs, packs and canteens.

definition.name: Treated Canvas
definition.desc: Cloth treated with salt and Bitterleaf at a fire. Competes with food and medicine.

definition.name: Field Repair Kit
definition.desc: Consume one from the pack to restore up to 100 durability to a repairable carried tool, away from a bench.

special: consume to restore up to 100 durability on a carried repairable item

definition.name: Trail Pack
definition.desc: Increases walking carry threshold by 20 kg. Occupies the back slot instead of a warm cloak.

special: equip back slot for walking carry threshold

definition.name: Trail Canteen
definition.desc: Holds 8 drinks or garden water. Crafted empty; refill at fresh water or a rain barrel.

special: crafted empty; drink and water plots; refill from fresh water or rain barrel

definition.name: Packed Fuel Briquette
definition.desc: Compact portable fuel: 90 seconds of burn. Packing sacrifices some charcoal energy.

definition.name: Plant Fiber
definition.desc: Grass and reed fiber. Rope, thatch, bandages.

definition.name: Frost Crystal
definition.desc: Cold-grown crystal from the north. Core synthesis.

definition.name: Raw Salt
definition.desc: Mineral crust chipped from coastal salt shale. Seasons a hearty roast.

definition.name: Root Broth
definition.desc: Cooked garden sunroot and Bitterleaf: restorative food with moisture.

definition.name: Herb Roast
definition.desc: A restorative cooked meal; Bitterleaf could instead become medicine.

definition.name: Salted Roast
definition.desc: Roast meat seasoned with gathered salt; a hearty field meal.

definition.name: Scrap Metal
definition.desc: Salvage from wrecks. Melts into iron.

definition.name: Spares
definition.desc: Run-local components. Research currency and advanced parts.

definition.name: Raw Hide
definition.desc: Cure at a workbench into leather.

definition.name: Crab Shell
definition.desc: Shore crab shell. Furnace flux for glass; competes with other uses of fuel and stone.

definition.name: Glass
definition.desc: Fused glass: furnace crystal, or stone with shell flux.

special: bush or oak bonus; harvested garden returns two
plant Sunroot or Bitterleaf (physical water or rain and chronological growth)

definition.name: Raw Meat
definition.desc: Risky raw. Cook at a campfire.

special: wild herb source or propagated Bitterleaf garden (seed + herb, water, time)
watered Sunroot garden; rain or flask

definition.name: Water Flask
definition.desc: Holds 4 drinks. Refill at fresh water or a rain barrel.

special: drink and water plots; refill from fresh water or rain barrel

definition.name: Survival Knife
definition.desc: Humble but honest. Cuts fiber and flesh; slow on wood.

definition.name: Stone Pickaxe
definition.desc: Breaks stone and ore. Pries scrap.

definition.name: Salvager Pick
definition.desc: An improved pick: faster work on rock, ore and wrecks. Requires an improved bench.

definition.name: Salvager Axe
definition.desc: An improved axe: more work per strike on timber. Requires an improved bench.

definition.name: Reinforced Spear
definition.desc: A durable long-reach spear made at an improved workbench.

definition.name: Torch
definition.desc: Light in the dark. Weak weapon; can ignite.

definition.name: Filter Mask
definition.desc: Blocks most radiation and toxic gas.

definition.name: Ember Core
definition.desc: Hurls a fireball that ignites trees and grass. Charge spent on release.

definition.name: Quake Core
definition.desc: Raises a spike line that shatters rocks into yield.

definition.name: Rime Core
definition.desc: Frost nova; freezes shallow water into walkable ice for a while.

definition.name: Blueprint
definition.desc: Use to learn the recipe it describes. Consumed once.

definition.name: Vault Keycard
definition.desc: Opens a sealed industrial door. Consumed.

definition.name: Ragnarok Cash
definition.desc: Physical, unsecured. Can be lost. Deposit in an owned Rương ký gửi.

special: finite Ragnarok cash chest at/after final 72h

definition.name: Rương ký gửi
definition.desc: Escrow chest. Place on owned land, then deposit physical Ragnarok cash into your profile.

definition.name: Hand Cart (packed)
definition.desc: Place to unpack a cargo cart.

claim.name: Claim Totem
claim.desc: Claims land (radius 6) as your home plot. PROPOSED ownership mechanism.

door_wood.name: Wood Door
door_wood.desc: E to open/close. Creatures cannot open doors.

roof_thatch.name: Thatch Roof
roof_thatch.desc: Over a floor. Enclosed + roofed = shelter.

campfire.name: Campfire
campfire.desc: Cooks with fuel. Warmth + light while burning.

furnace.name: Furnace
furnace.desc: Smelts with fuel. Output waits in its slots.

workbench.name: Workbench
workbench.desc: Timed crafting for tools, armor and parts.

research.name: Research Table
research.desc: Spend Spares or study specimens to unlock recipes.

garden.name: Garden Plot
garden.desc: Plant seeds; grows only while watered (rain counts).

spikes.name: Spike Trap
spikes.desc: Hurts creatures that walk over it.

escrow.name: Rương ký gửi
escrow.desc: Deposit physical Ragnarok cash into profile-secured cash.
